customers.evidence: Tesla continues to make products accessible and affordable to more and more people

employees.evidence: Tesla continues to provide on-the-job training and track performance daily

environment.evidence: Tesla’s mission is to accelerate the world’s transition to sustainable energy.

safety.evidence: To achieve our goal of having the safest factories in the world, Tesla is taking a proactive approach to safety

innovation.evidence: unveiled Tesla’s cutting-edge battery technology and electric powertrain

result.analyst_notes: Mission-led and aspirational, opening with a sustainable-energy goal. Mostly third-person Tesla, with first-person plural in 'our goal' and 'the future we want'. Hedged belief framing ('Tesla believes') sits beside absolute claims ('the best car in its class'). Product and performance facts dominate; stakeholder values are sparse.
